data: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.
Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.
Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.
Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.
Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.
Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.
Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.
Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.
Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.
Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.
Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.
Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.
Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.
Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.
Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.
Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.
Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.
Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.
Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.
Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage, heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed.
On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.
Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time.
Hold [W] while active to dash farther.
Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time
Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
+55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.
Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.
+10.0 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling
Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.
Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.
Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
-10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.
Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup.
The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel.
The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage.
Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel infront of Holliday.
Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback.
When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies.
Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.
On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health
Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage.
Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.
Per Bomb Touch : -6% Melee Resist for 6s
Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage.
If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.
+60 Damage & On Hero Hit: 50% Cooldown Refund
Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.
Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.
After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.
On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns

Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
+0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling
Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.
+12.0 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling
Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.
Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.
Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.
Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.
On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.
Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
Bullets also build up Lethal Venom
Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area.
Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
+1.0s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.
Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage.
Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.
Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage.
While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant.
Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.
Hex a target area and transforming all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration.
Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead.
Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points.
Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.
+7.0% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling
Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage.
Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.
Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence.
Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.
On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage
Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
Silences enemies for 2s if close range
Active: Accentuate your senses, revealing a trail that leads to nearby heroes.
Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar.
You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent weapon damage.
+3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina
Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.
Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself.
The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow.
Can be shot to detonate early.
Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position.
A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage.
+1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied.
15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 150s to 130s, August 18th, 2025.
Nox Nostra cooldown reduced from 130s to 115s
Rejuv only heals the person hitting the crystal Dying to a non-player (when there is no bounty/assists) now increases the respawn time for that death by…
